svg.aria-label: What Windows does as you sign out, shut down or restart. It runs the sign-out scripts one after another and waits for them, up to the policy's wait for all of them together, 600 seconds by default. Other scripts run first; wsl-spawner's hook, wsl-spawnerw.exe logoff, runs last, so a script that still needs WSL finds it running. The hook stops every running distribution of wsl-spawner's within stop_limit, then WSL. Then Windows signs you out. wsl-spawner hook install raises a wait shorter than stop_limit and a minute, and hook remove puts it back; check says when it is short.
